$comment: BNB Chain, named bsc because that is DexScreener's word for it and the file has to agree with the slug. The chain's own dataseed nodes answer eth_getLogs by topic with no contract address with 'limit exceeded' whatever the range, PublicNode's HTTP wants an address, dRPC's free plan caps the range and 1RPC allows fifty blocks; bloXroute's public endpoint and NodeReal's public one both take two thousand blocks with the whole roster in the filter and batches of twenty, so one is the endpoint and the other the fallback, and PublicNode's socket takes the topic-only subscription. Every stablecoin here carries eighteen decimals, unlike its namesake on Ethereum. Blocks are under a second, so config/limits.json is about right.
name: BNB Chain
